prompt:
Research the officially documented context window and output token limits of the current Claude and GPT model families. Cite the vendors' own documentation pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here are the officially documented context window and output token limits for the current Claude and GPT model families, based on vendor documentation.

### Claude Models (Anthropic)
Anthropic's current flagship models (such as Claude Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.5, Sonnet 5, and Fable 5.1) feature a 1M-token context window, while older/smaller models like Claude Haiku 4.5 use a 200k-token context window. The maximum output for the 1M context models is 128k tokens on the synchronous API (up to 300k on the Batch API), and 64k tokens for the 200k context models.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "Context window: 1M tokens · Max output: 128K tokens" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 5.5 has a 1M token context window and 128K max output tokens.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 support up to 300k output tokens with the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header." | CLAIM: Various Claude models support up to 300k output tokens on the Message Batches API.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "Context window: 1M tokens | 1M tokens | 1M tokens | 200k tokens" | CLAIM: The current Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, and Sonnet 5 models have a 1M token context window, while Claude Haiku 4.5 has a 200k token context window.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "Max output: 128k tokens | 128k tokens | 128k tokens | 64k tokens" | CLAIM: The 1M context Claude models have a max output of 128k tokens, while the 200k context models (Haiku 4.5) have a max output of 64k tokens.

### GPT Models (OpenAI)
OpenAI's GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini models have a 128k-token context window, while the o-series reasoning models vary (200k for o3/o4-mini, 128k for o1/o1-mini). The max output limits vary by model, with o3 allowing up to 100k output tokens.
